**Microsoft's Copilot agents gain memory, triggers and a Planner link.** Copilot Studio adds persistent agents with business-process memory and scheduled or event-based triggers; Copilot Cowork gets a Planner plugin; Microsoft 365 Copilot can now delete, move and categorise Outlook messages, with confirmation required for bulk changes. Secondary source summarising Microsoft's release notes. [Big Hat Group, 9 Nov 2026](https://www.bighatgroup.com/blog/copilot-weekly-2026-11-09/)

**Adobe's marketing agent now runs inside ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini and Copilot.** CX Enterprise Coworker is built on the MCP and Agent2Agent open standards, and Accenture, Deloitte Digital, EY, IBM and PwC are building industry-specific versions of it. Enterprise agents are starting to travel across assistants rather than stay inside one vendor's product. [The Next Web, 4 Nov 2026](https://thenextweb.com/news/adobe-cx-enterprise-coworker-chatgpt-claude-gemini-copilot)

**Google launches one work agent that routes jobs to Gemini or Claude models.** The Gemini agent can research, create documents, write code and complete tasks lasting hours or days, with its own Gmail, Calendar and Drive storage. It is in private preview for a select group of customers, with no date for wider availability. [VentureBeat, 8 Oct 2026](https://venturebeat.com/ai/google-cloud-unveils-persistent-gemini-agents-for-long-running-tasks-and-they-get-their-own-gmail-calendar-and-drive-storage)

**Claude now works inside Google Docs, Sheets and Slides.** Anthropic's Workspace add-on, in public beta on all paid Claude plans, opens Claude in a sidebar that reads the open file and edits it in place; by default each change waits for approval. **OpenAI introduced "dots", always-on personal agents.** Dots are powered by GPT-6 Astra, have their own cloud computer, connect to over 4,000 apps through plugins, and can be reached through ChatGPT, Slack or Teams. Rollout starts on Pro, Business Premium and Enterprise plans in eligible markets, with action review and approvals among the stated controls. [OpenAI, 29 Sep 2026](https://openai.com/index/introducing-dots/)
